bounds: account_id: acct-<n>, n a whole number from 1, never reused
cause: one of PAYER_CAUSES
checks: each one of CHECK_IDS, in their order
code: a code of AI_ACCOUNT_CHECKS, or of membership's or ai-catalogue's rows
detail: the row's translation with its placeholders filled
entries: at least one, each an entry of the plan, each once
flag_cause: one of PAYER_CAUSES
kind: one of USE_KINDS but explore
level: group, project or member
limit: whole number, 1 to HISTORY_LIMIT_MAX
means: one of MEANS, and one the plan allows
owner: group, project:<id> or member:<id>
position: whole number from 1, or null for an account of the owner's own that stands off the list
reason: 1 to 2,000 characters, not blank, whenever the limit is on
reference: store and locator each 1 to 512 characters, not blank
